notes.title: Putin Destroys Alien: Definitive Edition (Free Update For Everyone)
notes.notes:
\[New Features]

A New Reality: Enhanced visual and gameplay improvements, making you fully immerse yourself in the experience of an egyptian god

Transition Magic: Room transition reimagined

The Obama Update: he will now transform into a sphere and aid you in combat

Under The Influence: Added the effect of substances used

UI 2.0: Game UI overhaul, the menu is now alive

\[Gameplay]

Adjusted difficulty: You are now spawning with maximum power, *KILL ALL ALIENS INVADER*

Heavy Drinker: Grabbing the vodka will now give you even more spirit points

\[Bugfix]

Fix a resolution issue where the player is unable to enter the game after startup
